# GreyLeads (US)

> GreyLeads (GreyLeads Solutions Pvt Ltd) is a full-service digital marketing agency with a senior team in Bengaluru, India, working with businesses across the United States. One team runs B2B lead generation, builds websites and apps, manages Google, Meta, LinkedIn and YouTube ads, handles SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization), creates ad creative and brand identities, and automates CRM, email and SMS follow-up. We report on leads, sales and cost per customer.

## Key facts

- Name: GreyLeads (legal name: GreyLeads Solutions Pvt Ltd)
- Type: Digital marketing and lead generation agency
- Serves: businesses across the United States (US site: https://greyleads.us; India site: https://greyleads.in)
- Team location: RMZ Ecoworld, Building 6A, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India
- Calls: scheduled in the client's US time zone, on Zoom or Google Meet
- Founder and CEO: John Jayaseelan
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 70105 52833
- Email: contact@greyleads.in
- Pricing: marketing retainers from $1,500 a month; websites from $3,000; apps from $15,000; fixed quotes after a discovery call
- Contracts: a three-month starting period for marketing, then month to month
- Ownership: clients own their website, app code, ad accounts, creatives and data from day one

## Services

- [B2B lead generation](https://greyleads.us/lead-generation): verified B2B data, LinkedIn, Google and Meta lead campaigns, landing pages, lead scoring, CRM and instant follow-up. From $1,500/month.
- [Website design and development](https://greyleads.us/websites): fast, conversion-focused websites and e-commerce. From $3,000.
- [Mobile app development](https://greyleads.us/apps): iOS, Android and web apps. First versions from $15,000.
- [SEO and AEO](https://greyleads.us/seo-aeo): technical and local SEO, content, and visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI answers. From $1,200/month.
- [Performance marketing](https://greyleads.us/performance-marketing): Google, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn ads managed for leads and sales. From $1,500/month.
- [Creative ads](https://greyleads.us/creative-ads): video, UGC-style, static and carousel ads, tested every week. From $1,200/month.
- [Branding and social media](https://greyleads.us/branding): brand identity, guidelines and social media management. From $2,500.
- [Marketing automation](https://greyleads.us/automation): HubSpot, Salesforce and Zoho CRM setup, email and SMS sequences, sales alerts. From $2,000.

## Case studies

- [IAcharya](https://greyleads.us/work/iacharya): SEO and ad campaigns. Page 1 on Google within six months and 150+ course leads every month.
- [Greyweave](https://greyleads.us/work/greyweave): a brand-new website reached page 1 on Google in six months.
- [Pix.city](https://greyleads.us/work/pixcity): targeted, 100% verified decision-maker data across France and Europe.
- [Quadrate](https://greyleads.us/work/quadrate): targeted, 100% verified B2B data for a sales team.
- [SOLIZE](https://greyleads.us/work/solize): LinkedIn ad campaigns for a global digital engineering brand.
- [Jona's Cafe](https://greyleads.us/work/jonas-cafe): mobile app rebuilt for iOS and Android.
